meta.headline: No filed model picks to grade for this sport — see the notes below for why.
notes: No filed NFL model picks exist for any completed slate — the NFL pipeline files projections only (no lines, no sides), so there is nothing honest to grade. The Nov 5 JAX @ BAL pattern-vs-model verdicts were pre-game analysis for a game not yet played, not filed picks.
No filed NFL model picks exist in the board's data for any completed slate — nothing to grade.

Evidence: every board-refresh input for NFL carries projections only. data/v2_props_week9_payload.json and the other v2 payload files hold {name, proj} rows (medians per market, no lines, no sides). The per-game engine outputs in data/v2_props/ and data/v2_props_archive_20261104_2026utc/ hold player -> market -> {mean, median, p10, p90}. scripts/props_to_app.py (the board converter) emits projection triples only ([median, p10, p90]); scripts/run_week9_v2_worker.py likewise files projections, never picks.

Unlike the NBA (which has a filed A+ set in the run projections and a jury card), the NFL board derives any pick display at read time from projection vs live line and files nothing. The NFL jury/desk cards that exist in chat history were never filed into the board's data pipeline.

The Nov 5 JAX@BAL pattern-vs-model verdicts from the line-tracker study (Strange/Tuten/Thomas/Lawrence/Bateman/Hill/Henry/Andrews) are pre-game analysis for a game not yet played, not filed picks on a completed slate, so they are not graded here.
